lastResponse.text: I hear you, and that makes sense. Fast next step: call two one one in Oregon and ask for crisis support options that are not police-first. If you want, say this exactly: “Hi, my friend in Oregon City is spiraling. We don’t feel safe with cops or ER right now. What can we call or text immediately for mental health crisis support that won’t turn us away?” If there’s immediate danger, call nine one one.
